name: get_order_status
description: Look up the current status of a Fernbrook order by its order ID. Returns the order's status, type (retail or wholesale), order date, estimated delivery date, and item summary. Returns found: false if no order matches the given ID. This is a read-only lookup; it cannot modify an order.

order_id.description: The Fernbrook order ID to look up, for example FB-10293.
